**Source**: Code Review
**Novelty**: NEW
**Location**: crates/preloop-runner/src/listener/broker_listener.rs:751

## Description
Cancel/timeout through 3 mismatched paths (RunnerShutdown bypasses graceful worker shutdown; listener kill hits only worker PID, not step PGs; overlap omits force_fail_job). Dedup-before-parse leaves unacked msgs; kill windows/clocks differ. Matches historical orphan bugs.

## Trigger scenario
Broker RunnerShutdown (or overlap JobRequest/timeout) during active job with background step children (normal ops + timing).

## Developer intent
Graceful shutdown_gracefully + PG kill fallback (job_dispatcher.rs:261, process.rs:85); gaps vs intent.

## Reproduction result
```
ok. 2 passed; 0 failed (cancel_sends_sigint_before_hard_kill, shutdown_gracefully_lets_worker_cancel_and_exit)

Key observation: broker_listener.rs:751 returns Ok() WITHOUT shutdown_gracefully (F-1); job_dispatcher.rs:297 kill() misses PGs (F-2). Bad state permanent. (executed /private/tmp/Specula/runs/.../repro/test_bugCR-2_cancellation_sequencing.sh)
```

## Recommendation
Unify paths to always use full PG kill + force_fail + consistent timeouts; test all 3 sources × step groups.
